events.text: In BIAN 14.0, the Customer Agreement Service Domain maintains the master legal and regulatory agreements governing the overall relationship between the bank and a specific customer.

This agreement represents the overarching contractual framework under which one or more Sales Product Agreements are subsequently established. It acts as the primary legal contract and policy container between the bank and a customer.

items: Captures master legal terms, regulatory terms, policies and conditions
Defines regulatory, compliance, and jurisdictional considerations
Establishes governing provisions applicable across all product relationships
Serves as the contractual reference for all linked Sales Product Agreements

rows: Master legal terms, regulatory terms, policies, jurisdictional rules, authorised signatories
Manage product-specific terms (handled by Sales Product Agreement SD)
Manage operational account behaviour (handled by product SDs: Current Account, Loan, Card, etc.)
Legal foundation upon which all product agreements are executed
One Customer Agreement CR per customer master relationship
LegalTerms BQ, RegulatoryTerms BQ, PolicyTerms BQ — structured legal/regulatory/policy components under each CR

events.text: When to Use This Service Domain
Invoke this SD whenever a master contractual relationship must be established, validated, or maintained.
Scenario: A new corporate customer is being onboarded. Before any account, loan, or facility is created, the master agreement must be executed.
Action: The orchestration layer invokes the Customer Agreement SD to initiate a Customer Agreement Control Record. This ensures:

items: Legal terms are established
Regulatory compliance clauses are accepted
Jurisdictional rules are recorded
Authorised signatories are captured

events.text: Only after the Customer Agreement CR is established can Sales Product Agreements be initiated.
Scenario: A customer applies for a Personal Loan. Before initiating the Sales Product Agreement, the bank must confirm a valid Customer Agreement exists.
Action: The Sales Product Agreement SD invokes the Customer Agreement SD to:

items: Retrieve the active Customer Agreement instance
Validate that lending products are permitted under the master agreement
Confirm that the agreement status is not suspended or terminated
Verify that required regulatory clauses are included

events.text: Scenario: A regulatory rule change requires updated AML or cross-border provisions.
Action: The Customer Agreement SD is invoked to Update the master agreement terms. All linked Sales Product Agreements remain legally subordinate to this updated master agreement.
Scenario: A dispute arises regarding liability terms.
Action: Operations retrieve the Customer Agreement CR to determine governing law, limitation of liability clauses, and arbitration mechanisms.

This is a Legal Agreement Management domain. For each master agreement established for a customer, a separate Customer Agreement Control Record (CR) will be created. For each structured component of the agreement, a separate Behaviour Qualifier (BQ) instance is created under the CR.

rows: Master legal relationship record per customer. Captures agreement type, jurisdiction, validity period, signatories, and linked product agreements.
General banking terms & conditions, liability clauses, dispute resolution, governing law. Supports 1:M — multiple law references per BQ.
KYC declaration, FATCA/CRS self-certification, data privacy consent, AML clauses. Supports 1:M — one CR to many BQ instances.
Bank policies on digital banking usage, fee revisions, service eligibility conditions. Supports 1:M — one CR to many BQ instances.

items: Customer Agreement (CR) — Retail Banking Master Agreement
LegalTerms BQ — General T&Cs, liability, dispute resolution, governing law
RegulatoryTerms BQ — KYC, FATCA/CRS, data privacy consent
PolicyTerms BQ — Digital banking policy, fee revision policy, service eligibility

rows: Create and assess a new CR. Establishes the master legal relationship, captures governing provisions, confirms agreement is valid before any Sales Product Agreement is initiated.
Create and assess a LegalTerms BQ. Records structured legal clauses, defines governing law and liability provisions, ensures enforceability.
Amend an existing LegalTerms BQ when legal clauses change due to regulatory updates, policy revisions, or jurisdictional adjustments.
Create and assess a RegulatoryTerms BQ. Records KYC, AML, FATCA/CRS, and data privacy clauses.
Amend an existing RegulatoryTerms BQ when regulatory frameworks change.
Create and assess a PolicyTerms BQ. Records bank policies applicable to the customer relationship.
Amend an existing PolicyTerms BQ when internal bank policies are revised.

events.text: The following events require update operations on the Customer Agreement:

items: Agreement terms are revised
Regulatory frameworks change (e.g. new AML rules, cross-border provisions)
Customer status changes impact agreement applicability
Legal reviews require structured updates
Authorised signatories change

events.text: This is a Legal Agreement Management domain — not a financial processing domain. Data captured must represent structured agreement metadata, not operational or transactional data.

rows: Agreement Type, Jurisdiction, Agreement Valid From/To Date (DateTimePeriod)
Customer ID (CIF), Legal Entity Reference, Organisation Name, Organisation ID, Organisation Type
Agreement Signatories Responsible Parties (array — 1:M for multiple signatories)
Sales Product Agreement References (array — 1:M for multiple product links)
Document Directory Entry Instance Reference — links to stored agreement documents
Party Lifecycle Management Reference — Phase Name, Phase Status
Jurisdiction, Applicable Law References (array — law type, description, penalty, guideline, rule name, rule ID, rule status, interpretation)
Regulatory Authority, Applicable Regulation References (array — regulation definition, rule name, rule ID, rule dates, rule status, interpretation)
Bank Policy Rule Type, Policy Rule References (policy definition, name, ID, status, dates, involved party, interpretation)

events.text: The following enhancements were applied while preserving BIAN structure:

rows: PartyReference → string (for v13, not needed for v14)
PartyReference property modified to contain a string to avoid recursive loop generation in schema
Made an array (1:M) to support multiple signatories per agreement
Made an array (1:M) to support multiple product agreements linked to a single Customer Agreement CR
Made an array (1:M) to capture multiple legal agreements within one BQ
Entire RegulatoryTerms BQ object supports 1:M relationship (one CR to many BQ instances). ApplicableRegulationReference also made an array.
Entire PolicyTerms BQ object supports 1:M relationship (one CR to many BQ instances)
Changed data type from DateTime to DateTimePeriod so both agreement start and end date can be stored in a single field
Added /CustomerAgreement/customerinformationprofile/{customerinformationprofileid}/Retrieve to allow retrieval using CIF ID instead of UUID
CIF ID is passed and stored in Customer Agreement table instead of UUID for direct lookup
This SD has its own DB schema to store data in accordance with BIAN API payloads
Unique identifier used to represent the customer/party within the banking system.
Specifies the category or type of organisation such as corporate, partnership, government entity, or private company.
Unique identification number assigned to the organisation/legal entity.
Date and time from which the organisation identifier becomes active or valid.
Date and time until which the organisation identifier remains valid.
Significant business-related date associated with the organisation, such as incorporation or establishment date.
Defines the purpose/type of organisation date, for example IncorporationDate or RegistrationDate.
Official registered name of the organisation/legal entity.
Specifies the type/category of agreement established between the bank and the customer.
Start date from which the agreement becomes effective.
Expiry/end date until which the agreement remains valid.
Identifier of the customer or party authorised to sign or approve the agreement.
Unique identifier of the document record stored in the document directory repository.
Specifies the type of product-level agreement associated with the banking product or service.
Unique identifier assigned to the specific product agreement.
Indicates the current lifecycle stage of the customer/party, such as onboarding, active, suspended, or closed.
Represents the current operational status of the customer lifecycle process.
